signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Logo mark, link text, icon accents, brand-colored borders and fills — the single chromatic anchor that signals the brand across an otherwise achromatic interface

ink.$description: Ink — Dark supporting neutral for text, icons, and strong contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper.$description: Paper — Page background, card surface, button surface — the dominant canvas

hairline.$description: Hairline — Dividers, card borders, input borders, subtle structural separation

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, descriptions, muted labels, caption text

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, meta labels, inactive nav items, placeholder content

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark surface for filled buttons and emphasis panels

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — SVG icon fills, deepest contrast for illustration artwork

mint.$description: Mint — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

forest.$description: Forest — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

amber.$description: Amber — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

sunburst.$description: Sunburst — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

rust.$description: Rust — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

crimson.$description: Crimson — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

maroon.$description: Maroon — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ultraviolet.$description: Ultraviolet — Illustration accent violet, tag variant

iris.$description: Iris — Illustration accent purple, tag variant

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Illustration accent blue, tag variant

midnight.$description: Midnight — Illustration accent indigo, tag variant

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Soft violet surface wash, subtle card highlight

ui-sans-serif-system-inter-geist-sans-sf.$value: ui-sans-serif (system: Inter / Geist Sans / SF Pro)
ui-sans-serif-system-inter-geist-sans-sf.$description: All UI text — body at 14px/1.43, labels and tags at 12px/1.33, navigation at 13–14px, subheadings at 16–18px, and display headings at 30px. The 30px display step is notably restrained — this system does not shout at scale; it informs through compact hierarchy

geist-mono.$description: Numeric data displays (invoice amounts, invoice numbers, code labels, metrics) — the monospace brings technical precision to data-heavy illustration cards. 10–12px for inline code/metric tags, 24–30px for prominent figures

mulish.$description: Mulish — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
